findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product_details, try_it_free, compare_products, attest_page, check_service, find_service, read_page, screenshot_page, web_search, page_brief, read_pages, pdf_to_text, price_history · Private data: get_product_details, attest_page, verify_attestation, check_my_balance, check_service, read_page, screenshot_page, wallet_balance, token_info, transaction_lookup, token_price, sec_company, ip_lookup, weather_forecast, exchange_rate, token_check, wallet_portfolio, airport_delays, geocode_address, pdf_to_text, pretrade_check, x402_market_dataset, price_history · Public sink: get_product_details, find_service · Destructive: try_it_free, check_my_balance, wallet_balance, company_due_diligence.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product_details, try_it_free, compare_products, attest_page, check_service, find_service, read_page, screenshot_page, web_search, page_brief, read_pages, pdf_to_text, price_history · Private data: get_product_details, attest_page, verify_attestation, check_my_balance, check_service, read_page, screenshot_page, wallet_balance, token_info, transaction_lookup, token_price, sec_company, ip_lookup, weather_forecast, exchange_rate, token_check, wallet_portfolio, airport_delays, geocode_address, pdf_to_text, pretrade_check, x402_market_dataset, price_history · Public sink: get_product_details, find_service · Destructive: try_it_free, check_my_balance, wallet_balance, company_due_diligence

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
